note: Every file under mobile/www/vendor/ is produced from a repository source by this generator. sourceSha256 proves the mobile app runs the reviewed bytes; emittedSha256 is what the app's Build-integrity screen displays and what --check compares on disk.

artifacts.why: The sha256-pinned deterministic shared core. Generated by web/tools/build-core-bundle.js; its own header pins every embedded core/ source. Installs window.PolicyVaultCore.

The pure createVerifyIntent(core) pre-sign verifier — the DO-NOT-SIGN decision itself. DOM-free by construction; installs window.PolicyVaultVerifyIntent when a core bundle is present, and a permanently-refusing instance when it is not.
The zero-runtime-dependency PolicyVault API client (transport only: no financial authority, no policy semantics, no verification). Node CommonJS, so it is host-wrapped rather than copied raw.
